proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Seeking Support for the Descheduling of Cannabis
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that the Company announce its support for the descheduling of cannabis.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Report Regarding Direct and Indirect Political Contributions
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying and political contributions, trade association payments, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Report on Policies and Practices Regarding Contract Animal Laboratories
proposals.proponent: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to strengthen policies and practices regarding contract animal laboratories and issue a report to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Report on the Extent to Which Risks Related to Public Concern Over Drug Pricing Strategies are Integrated into Incentive Compensation Arrangements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on whether senior executive incentive compensation integrates risks related to public concern over drug pricing.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal.
